sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.SystemAlertId, s.AlertName, h.HostName, i.Address, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SecurityAlert AS bad WHERE bad.AlertName = %s AND COALESCE(JSON_VALID(bad.Entities), 0) = 0) AS UnparsedAlertCount FROM SecurityAlert AS s JOIN JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.Entities) THEN s.Entities ELSE '[]' END, '$[*]' COLUMNS(EntityType VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.Type', HostName VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.HostName')) AS h ON h.EntityType = 'host' JOIN JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(s.Entities) THEN s.Entities ELSE '[]' END, '$[*]' COLUMNS(EntityType VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.Type', Address VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.Address')) AS i ON i.EntityType = 'ip' WHERE h.HostName IN (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s) AND s.AlertName = %s LIMIT 100
